identity.welcomeMessage: Join us in exploring how everyday movement and exercise shape energy and mood.

participantID.label: Participant Code
participantID.helpText: Enter the code exactly as it appears in your study invitation.

pages.title: Small movements matter
pages.body: Future activity summaries will help reveal patterns across active and restful days.

pages.title: Build a steady rhythm
pages.body: Study streaks will eventually help you remember brief daily check-ins without inventing performance goals.

healthKit.rationale: With your permission, this study reads steps, active energy, and exercise time. Local See My Data summaries stay on this device; configured samples may be sent to this study’s verified Study Backend.

notifications.rationale: Optional reminders can help you remember configured Inoxity activities.

surveys.name: Energy check-in
surveys.description: A quick reflection on movement and energy.
surveys.instructions: Open the external check-in during its evening availability window.
surveys.privacyText: Inoxity does not read or store your survey responses.

reminders.title: Inoxity
reminders.body: Your study information is available in the app.

media.instructions: Choose a short activity video when requested, then tap Upload to send it.
media.privacyText: Selected media is uploaded directly to this study's secure server and is not kept on this device afterward.

categories.description: A short video representing an activity session.

faqs.question: Do I need to reach a step goal?
faqs.answer: No. This study is interested in your usual routine.

faqs.question: How is Apple Health data handled?
faqs.answer: Only configured types are read. Local See My Data summaries are not uploaded, while configured samples may be sent to this study’s verified Study Backend. Inoxity does not write to Apple Health, and deleted Apple Health samples are not yet mirrored remotely.

faqs.question: Are videos uploaded now?
faqs.answer: No. Video selection and local storage are available, but remote media upload is not implemented.

completion.title: Activity study complete
completion.message: Thank you for sharing your everyday experience.
